description: 3DIMLI is a creator storefront and digital commerce platform for creators to sell digital downloads, software, games, AI models, graphics, audio, video, ebooks, link products, and 3D models from one branded store. It's built as a stronger alternative to Gumroad, Ko-fi, Payhip, SendOwl, Sellfy, Lemon Squeezy, Stan Store, Whop, Shopify, and WooCommerce — giving creators full control over branding, storefront ownership, and customer relationships.
